name: APP-CHMINACA RM
summary: PX-3 (also known as APP-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid.6 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 47.6 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.
